fixture_notice: BENCHMARK FIXTURE - synthetic cases authored for internal regression benchmarking of the AI Scientist Evolution Lab. Documents, hypotheses, designs and numbers are illustrative; they are not research findings, not real data and must never be presented as discoveries.
description: Assess hypothesis quality. Subject returns {falsifiable, measurable, metric_named} booleans; scored by per-label accuracy.

label_definitions.falsifiable: Judged on logical form: the hypothesis makes a directional or comparative prediction or states an explicit falsification criterion, without hedging ('may or may not', 'could possibly', 'in some way', 'under certain conditions') and is not a tautology or a bare evaluative claim. Whether the outcome is operationalised is judged separately by 'measurable'.
label_definitions.measurable: The dependent variable is an observable quantity with an implied or stated measurement procedure (not an abstract construct such as 'understanding' or 'creativity').
label_definitions.metric_named: A specific, named metric is given (e.g. AUROC, expected calibration error, cycle life at 80% capacity retention).

input.statement: Replacing post-LayerNorm with pre-LayerNorm in a 12-layer transformer will reduce the fraction of diverging training runs from above 50% to below 10% without warmup.
input.falsification_criterion: divergence rate of 10% or more with pre-LayerNorm

input.statement: Better prompts may or may not make the assistant more helpful in some situations.
Adding 2 wt% fluoroethylene carbonate to the electrolyte will increase the number of cycles to 80% capacity retention of Li||NMC cells by at least 30% relative to the additive-free electrolyte.
input.falsification_criterion: cycle-life gain below 30% across 5 cells per arm

input.statement: The new retrieval strategy could help the research agent's scientific understanding in some way.
Scaffold-split test AUROC of the graph network will be lower than its random-split AUROC on the same molecular dataset.
input.prediction: scaffold-split AUROC lower than random-split AUROC
input.falsification_criterion: scaffold-split AUROC greater than or equal to random-split AUROC

input.statement: Oxide-derived copper will produce more ethylene than polished copper under identical electrolysis conditions.
input.dependent_variable: ethylene production measured by gas chromatography
input.prediction: higher ethylene production on oxide-derived copper

input.statement: Either the model's calibration improves after fine-tuning or it does not.
Students who use the tutoring agent will become more creative.
Under certain conditions, larger batch sizes could possibly affect generalisation.
Patient-level splitting will lower the reported AUROC of the chest radiograph classifier by at least 0.03 compared with image-level splitting.
input.falsification_criterion: AUROC drop smaller than 0.03 over 5 folds

input.statement: Increasing the number of retrieved passages from 5 to 20 will reduce the rate of unsupported statements in generated literature summaries.
input.dependent_variable: rate of unsupported statements per summary
